mapper.select: SELECT id, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json FROM command_idempotency WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO command_idempotency(id, request_key, canonical_version, params_sha256, params_canonical, status, receipt_json, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestKey}, #{canonicalVersion}, #{paramsSha256}, #{paramsCanonical}, 'RESERVED', NULL, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.update: UPDATE command_idempotency SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', receipt_json = #{receiptJson}, succeeded_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} AND status = 'RESERVED'
mapper.sql: s.id, s.merchant_id, s.store_id, s.category_id, s.service_name, s.description, s.price, s.list_price, s.duration_minutes, s.fulfillment_type, s.cover_asset_id, s.applicable_pet_types, s.staff_requirement, s.verification_required, s.aftersale_note, s.remark, s.status, s.submission_no, s.owner_user_id, s.submitted_at, s.version, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM service_item s WHERE s.id = #{serviceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_item(id, merchant_id, store_id, owner_user_id, category_id, service_name, description, price, list_price, duration_minutes, fulfillment_type, cover_asset_id, applicable_pet_types, staff_requirement, verification_required, aftersale_note, remark, status, submission_no, submitted_at, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{merchantId}, #{storeId}, #{ownerUserId}, #{categoryId}, #{serviceName}, #{description}, #{price}, #{listPrice}, #{durationMinutes}, #{fulfillmentType}, #{coverAssetId}, #{applicablePetTypes}, #{staffRequirement}, #{verificationRequired}, #{aftersaleNote}, #{remark}, 'DRAFT', 0, NULL, 0, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE service_item SET category_id = #{categoryId}, service_name = #{serviceName}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, list_price = #{listPrice}, duration_minutes = #{durationMinutes}, fulfillment_type = #{fulfillmentType}, cover_asset_id = #{coverAssetId}, applicable_pet_types = #{applicablePetTypes}, staff_requirement = #{staffRequirement}, verification_required = #{verificationRequired}, aftersale_note = #{aftersaleNote}, remark = #{remark}, version = version + 1, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('DRAFT', 'REJECTED', 'OFFLINE')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM service_category WHERE status = 'ENABLED' ORDER BY sort_no ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_review_decision(id, service_id, submission_no, decision_type, opinion, decided_by_operator_id, decided_at, authz_version, scope_version, request_id, trace_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{serviceId}, #{submissionNo}, #{decisionType}, #{opinion}, #{operatorId}, #{decidedAt}, #{authzVersion}, #{scopeVersion}, #{requestId}, #{traceId}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, service_id, submission_no, decision_type, opinion, decided_by_operator_id, decided_at, authz_version, scope_version, request_id, trace_id, created_at FROM service_review_decision WHERE service_id = #{serviceId} ORDER BY decided_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO service_governance_action(id, service_id, action_type, reason, acted_by_operator_id, acted_at, authz_version, scope_version, request_id, trace_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{serviceId}, 'FORCE_OFFLINE', #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{actedAt}, #{authzVersion}, #{scopeVersion}, #{requestId}, #{traceId}, #{now})
mapper.sql: SELECT s.id AS serviceId, s.merchant_id AS merchantId, s.store_id AS storeId, s.service_name AS serviceName, s.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, s.status AS status, s.price AS price, s.list_price AS listPrice, s.submission_no AS submissionNo, s.submitted_at AS submittedAt, s.version AS version, COALESCE(rc.reject_count, 0) AS rejectCount FROM service_item s LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT service_id, COUNT(*) AS reject_count FROM service_review_decision WHERE decision_type = 'REJECT' GROUP BY service_id) rc ON rc.service_id = s.id
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS serviceId, s.merchant_id AS merchantId, s.store_id AS storeId, s.service_name AS serviceName, s.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, s.status AS status, s.price AS price, s.list_price AS listPrice, s.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, s.fulfillment_type AS fulfillmentType, s.cover_asset_id AS coverAssetId, s.description AS description, s.submission_no AS submissionNo, s.submitted_at AS submittedAt, s.version AS version, s.updated_at AS updatedAt, COALESCE(rc.reject_count, 0) AS rejectCount FROM service_item s LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT service_id, COUNT(*) AS reject_count FROM service_review_decision WHERE decision_type = 'REJECT' GROUP BY service_id) rc ON rc.service_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{serviceId}
mapper.sql: SELECT s.id AS serviceId, s.merchant_id AS merchantId, s.store_id AS storeId, s.service_name AS serviceName, s.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, s.status AS status, s.price AS price, s.list_price AS listPrice, s.duration_minutes AS durationMinutes, s.fulfillment_type AS fulfillmentType, s.cover_asset_id AS coverAssetId, s.applicable_pet_types AS applicablePetTypes, s.staff_requirement AS staffRequirement, s.verification_required AS verificationRequired, s.description AS description, s.aftersale_note AS aftersaleNote, s.remark AS remark, s.submission_no AS submissionNo, s.submitted_at AS submittedAt, s.version AS version, s.updated_at AS updatedAt, lr.decision_id AS latestRejectDecisionId, lr.submission_no AS latestRejectSubmissionNo, lr.opinion AS latestRejectOpinion, lr.decided_at AS latestRejectDecidedAt FROM service_item s LEFT JOIN service_category c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.service_id, d.id AS decision_id, d.submission_no, d.opinion, d.decided_at FROM service_review_decision d JOIN (SELECT service_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM service_review_decision WHERE decision_type = 'REJECT' GROUP BY service_id) m ON m.max_id = d.id) lr ON lr.service_id = s.id
